title: analysis host JSONL records
description: Records appended by analysis/host.py (plugins in analysis/plugins.py) under <data-dir>/analysis, one JSON object per line, discriminated by `k`. `t` is PC wall-clock Unix seconds of the 1 s analysis window (transients carry the frame time inside the window). Beams are 1-based (1..8 = bridge slots 0-7 = matrix inputs 1..8). Metadata only: no audio is written by the record streams; audio can only be written by the explicit --clip-audio option of the wildlife clip capture (interface `clips`, off by default, status.json audio_written). Receivers MUST ignore unknown fields. Added in 1.1.0: the `bird_filtered` kind (out-of-region audit record). Added in 1.2.0 (all optional, forward-only: rows written before keep lacking them): tonal_appeared / tonal_gone / tonal_state lines gain `beam` (1..8 or null: the most recent confident per-beam attribution of the line; null when the two strongest beams are within 1.5 dB or the tone is not clear in the 1.37 s segment, because the array is nearly omni) and tonal_appeared `beam_margin_db`; `spatial` gains `decorr`; `bird` and `bird_filtered` gain `in_region`, `non_species` and `group`; `bird_filtered` gains `reject_reason`; `novelty` and `novel_event` rows gain `run` and `mv`. Still NOT part of the contract: `electronic` (tonal lines) and the `non_species` / `in_region` fields of `bird` records (receivers ignore them).

model.description: 1.3.0, optional on tags, clap, bird, bird_filtered. Which model produced the record: name, version (null when unknown), variant = the input policy applied to the same weights, sha256 = of the model file or the pinned weights blob (null when unreadable).

claim.description: 1.3.0, optional. A model output is an opinion: human_verified is always false, source always model_opinion.

max_unstored_score.description: 1.3.0, optional. Best score of a label that is not in top_k (the 6th best); null when the model exposes none.

bird_top_k.description: 1.3.0, optional. The up to 5 best detections of the beam's window (stored and location-filtered), largest first: [scientific name or common name, confidence].

dsp.description: 1 Hz level record. rms_dbfs is per beam (index 0 = beam 1). band_pct is the share of energy in 5 fixed bands, summing to about 100.

transient.description: A 20 ms frame more than 6 dB over the running median. beam_spread_db is the loudest-minus-quietest beam in that frame (small = diffuse).

tonal_state.description: Every ~10 s: the currently announced tonal lines (sorted by hz) and the noise floor of the beam mean.

spatial.description: Azimuth estimate from the 8-beam energy ring. UNCALIBRATED: the ring ordering is measured, absolute beam centres are not (calibrated is always false in 1.0.0). e_rel_db is each beam's level relative to the loudest (max 0).

decorr.description: 1.2.0, optional. Cross-beam decorrelation index of the 200-4000 Hz filtered 1 s window: 1 - the mean zero-lag Pearson correlation over the 8 ring-adjacent beam pairs (i, i+1 mod 8); unit-less, clipped to [0, 1], 3 decimals; 0 = identical waveforms in every adjacent pair. An UNVALIDATED proxy for wind/rain turbulence (no ground truth exists): calibrate on a quiet day before reading absolute values.

source.description: Emitted when two consecutive windows are directional.

tags.description: PANNs CNN14 AudioSet tagging of one beam. `top` keeps labels with probability >= 0.05 (up to 5, possibly none). Invariant: emb_stored == not speech_active (a window scored as speech stores no embedding).

top_k.description: 1.3.0, optional. The 5 best of the 527 classes, largest first, no probability floor.

clap.description: LAION-CLAP zero-shot over a fixed prompt list; always the top 3 prompts.

top_k.description: 1.3.0, optional. The 5 best prompts, largest first.

bird.description: One BirdNET detection on one of the two strongest beams. `provenance` is always the string model_opinion: a detection is the model's guess, never ground truth. common/scientific/confidence are nullable because the plugin copies them with dict.get.

in_region.description: 1.2.0: the location filter verdict; null = filter off or label not judged.

non_species.description: 1.2.0: a sound class (Engine, Dog ...), not a species.

group.description: 1.2.0: taxonomic group copied verbatim from ui/taxa.json (bird, insect, amphibian, mammal, mechanical) or other-bio for a genus the table does not list; null when the table was missing (counted in status meta.taxa_missing).

score_floor.description: 1.3.0, optional. The analyzer's --min-conf: BirdNET returns no score below it, so max_unstored_score is null.

bird_filtered.description: Audit record (analysis-records 1.1.0): a BirdNET detection that the county-level location/date species filter judged NOT expected here. The record is kept and flagged, not dropped; it is written only when the filter is on (`--geo-config`), next to the `bird` records of the same window. Same fields as `bird` except that `in_region` is present and always false. From 1.2.0 it also carries `reject_reason` (`geo_not_predicted`: the species is not on the location/date list; the library reports only a membership flag, never a score), `non_species` and `group`. `provenance` is always model_opinion. No location is ever stored in a record.

score_floor.description: 1.3.0, optional. The analyzer's --min-conf: BirdNET returns no score below it, so max_unstored_score is null.

novelty.description: Online k-means scene model over stored (non-speech) embeddings. During warm-up the record is the short shape {state: warming_up, seen}.

run.description: 1.2.0: analyzer start (Unix s, int) = run_id of the analysis_config record.

mv.description: 1.2.0: model version, e.g. km12-sk1.7.2; gains -from<ver> when the state was fitted by another scikit-learn.

then.description: Warm-up shape {k, t, state, seen}: no scene/dist/score/novel.

else.description: Scored shape. `novel` is decided on the unrounded score (> 3.0) but `score` is published rounded to 2 decimals, so a novel record can show exactly 3.0.

novel_event.description: Three consecutive novelty scores above 3.0 (unrounded; the published score is rounded to 2 decimals, so it may read 3.0).
